name: Metropolitan Museum of Art Collection API
tagline: Open access REST API for Met collection objects, images, and metadata.
description: Free, no-auth public API for The Metropolitan Museum of Art's collection. Search and retrieve object records (titles, artists, dates, departments), image URLs, and related metadata for open-access works. Built for education, research apps, and cultural heritage projects; rate-limited but free for non-commercial and most commercial use under Met Open Access policy.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public endpoints; no API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free; no paid plans. Rate limit 80 requests/second.

rate_limits: 80 requests per second (published on official docs).

example.response_snippet: {"objectID":436535,"isHighlight":true,"accessionNumber":"1980.305","accessionYear":"1980","isPublicDomain":true,"primaryImage":"https://images.metmuseum.org/CRDImages/ep/original/DT1567.jpg","department":"European Paintings","objectName":"Painting","title":"Wheat Field with Cypresses","culture":"","period":"","artistDisplayName":"Vincent van Gogh","objectDate":"1889","medium":"Oil on canvas","classification":"Paintings","repository":"Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY","objectURL":"https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/436535"}

use_cases: look up a Met object by ID with title artist and image URL
search collection objects by keyword or department
list all object IDs in a department for bulk export
fetch open-access primary and additional image URLs for a work
check whether an object is public domain before using its image
browse Met departments and object counts for a museum browser app
